name: KiCad MCP Pro
description: Open KiCad MCP Pro tools from a KiCad 10 PCB Editor IPC companion.
description_full: Native KiCad 10 IPC companion for the PCB Editor. A lightweight read-only desktop window displays the active board, selected item count and local KiCad MCP Pro status. The existing separately installed backend provides the engineering tools and retains authentication and approval boundaries. This package requires KiCad 10 with IPC enabled and a graphical wxPython-enabled Python runtime; the IPC package is under development.
